description: Standalone Web IDE with Native File System Access & Direct Disk Saving
author: KeshavSoft
features: Native File System Access API (Open & Direct Disk Save)
Automatic dirty state & unsaved changes tracking
Ctrl+S keyboard shortcut for instant persistence
Built-in code formatter (JSON, JS, HTML, CSS)
Graceful fallback for browsers without File System Access API
Ahead-of-Time compiled styling with zero runtime bloat

quickTips.open: Click 'Open' or press Ctrl+O to pick a file from your hard drive
quickTips.edit: Modify content directly in the Monaco editor
quickTips.format: Click 'Format' or press Shift+Alt+F to reformat code
quickTips.save: Click 'Save' or press Ctrl+S to save changes directly back to disk
